messages:
Leah - DevEx: quick heads up: Python sampleapp lost x-request-id + traceparent after auth retry. First request has headers, retry doesn't. Using OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation + contextvars. Any ideas?

Diego - SDK: is the retry using requests.Session.send or rebuilding a new Request? Rebuilds often forget headers.

Sam - SampleApps: sampleapp uses a small wrapper. Snippet: 
```py
def send_with_retry(prepared):
    resp = session.send(prepared)
    if resp.status_code == 401:
        refresh_tokens()
        new_req = requests.Request(prepared.method, prepared.url, data=prepared.body)
        prepared2 = session.prepare_request(new_req)
        return session.send(prepared2)
    return resp
```

Morgan - Infra: yep that drops prepared.headers. Also check tenant redact ruleswe had a case where `.*id.*` masked x-request-id in logs even if header present.

Leah - DevEx: repro: `XID=r-xyz curl -i -H "x-request-id: $XID" -d '{"t":"x"}' http://localhost:8000/api/gen` logs: incoming headers show x-request-id, outgoing after retry shows {}

Diego - SDK: two fixes: change sampleapp to copy headers when rebuilding, and SDK/otel instrumentation should WARN if outgoing HTTP lacks propagation headers while context has a trace. I'll file an issue and a small opt-in strict mode.

Sam - SampleApps: pushing fix: `requests.Request(..., headers=dict(prepared.headers), data=prepared.body)` and adding unit test asserting x-request-id survives retry. PR: https://rwd.in/pr/4781

Morgan - Infra: infra tests backlog: add integration test that triggers 401 refresh and asserts trace continuity in staging. Also update docs to warn against greedy redact regex.

DeployBot: Staging check: sampleapp v0.7.2 uses old impl; trace continuity test failing 3/5.

Leah - DevEx: confirmed PR passes local CI and staging verify shows trace preserved. Closing once PR merges. Thanks :thumbsup:
